purpose: Visually reviewed development/regression fixture; not held-out evaluation data.
annotation_method: Every listed data/norm filename was opened individually as a full image with functions.read in the final audit. Earlier contact-sheet interpretations were rejected and corrected. Main-session visual corrections were independently re-opened at the exact source paths. Detector predictions are not ground truth.
coordinate_system: Original data/norm PNG pixels, top-left origin; bounds are [x0, y0, x1, y1], approximate enclosing rectangles, not OCR segmentation boxes.

label_policy.pureverse: No running prose or editorial introduction. Titles, author names, dedications, page numbers, portraits and illustrations do not count as prose.
label_policy.hasprose: At least one genuine prose passage, including editorial/biographical introductions on poetry pages.
label_policy.expected_max_prose_blocks: null on positive pages: arbitrary OCR splitting/merging is not manually prescribed. Zero on pureverse pages is a strict rejection target.
label_policy.regions: Prose regions are independent visual recall targets. Verse regions are exclusion targets. Bounds include whitespace and are not exhaustive pixel masks; do not require exact box equality or assume everything outside them is verse.
